triples.subject: instrument_jaxa_ebit
triples.context:
We performed photoexcitation spectroscopy using the
JAXA-EBIT at the SPring-8 soft X-ray beamline, to pre-
cisely measure atomic data of the astronomically important
Ne-like Fe16+Lαtransitions.
